metadata.method: Epic unreal-mcp BlueprintTools (get_connected_subgraph on AnimGraph root, read_graph_dsl on EventGraph) + unreal-py node struct export_text + generated-class CDO read
metadata.purpose: Mechanical record of every runtime formula ABP_MH_LiveLink applies AROUND PA_MetaHuman_ARKit_Mapping. These are the rules V3 must invert/account for beyond the PoseAsset table itself (see v3/data/pa_mapping.json).

animGraphChainProcessedBranch: ModifyCurve BLEND: CurveMap = CustomControlValues (user override map, default empty)
ModifyCurve BLEND alpha=1: mouthClose block (see mouthCloseRule)
ModifyCurve BLEND alpha=TeethShowAlpha: 8 teeth-show curves = 1.0 (see teethShowCurves)
LayeredBoneBlend (BasePose=BodyPose, BlendWeights_0=1.0, curve_blend_option=OVERRIDE, mode=BRANCH_FILTER, layer_setup=[{}] i.e. branch filter configured in editor)
ModifyCurve BLEND alpha=1: HeadRoll/HeadYaw/HeadPitch from ARKit_HeadRotation (see headRotationRule)
BlendPosesByBool (bActiveValue=IsMHFDS, blend times 0.1s): TRUE -> raw LiveLinkPose passthrough (MHFDS/MHA input needs NO mapping), FALSE -> the processed chain above

mouthCloseRule.note: SafeDivide returns 0 when divisor is 0. This is the ONLY place MouthClose influences the MetaHuman - there is no MouthClose pose in the PoseAsset. V3 reverse rule must synthesize ARKit MouthClose from lipsTogether* (and jawOpen) curves.

jawOpenOverride.note: Manual/runtime override only - inactive by default, not part of the mapping.

teethShowOverride.note: Manual/runtime override only - inactive by default.

headRotationRule.eventGraph: IsMHFDS = bool(LiveLinkGetPropertyValue(frame, 'CTRL_expressions_mouthUp')) OR ForceMHFDS; if (!IsMHFDS AND LLink_Face_Head): ARKit_HeadRotation = MakeRotator(Roll=headYaw*50.0, Pitch=headRoll*50.0, Yaw=headPitch*-50.0)
headRotationRule.makeRotatorArgOrder: UE KismetMathLibrary.MakeRotator(Roll, Pitch, Yaw) - so the ARKit head channels are CROSS-ASSIGNED into rotator slots (headYaw->Roll slot, headRoll->Pitch slot, headPitch->negated Yaw slot). v2 KB paraphrased this differently; this is the literal 5.8 wiring.
headRotationRule.animGraphConsumption: ARKit_HeadRotation -> ToQuaternion -> Euler(Quat) -> BreakVector: X -> HeadRoll curve, Z -> HeadYaw curve, Y -> HeadPitch curve (Blend, alpha 1). HeadControlSwitch set to 1.0 immediately before.
headRotationRule.note: Head is out of scope for the V3 remap definition (body mocap owns the head), but recorded for the live-preview ABP template.

mhfdsSwitch.detection: presence/truthiness of CTRL_expressions_mouthUp property on the Live Link frame (Basic role), OR ForceMHFDS variable
mhfdsSwitch.meaning: TRUE = subject already streams MetaHuman-space curves (MHA real-time / MHFDS) -> PoseAsset mapping is BYPASSED entirely; FALSE = ARKit-space subject (Live Link Face) -> full processed chain
mhfdsSwitch.v3Relevance: Confirms MHA real-time subjects stream CTRL_expressions_* curves (the sniff tests for CTRL_expressions_mouthUp). Final on-wire curve-name verification still pending a live stream test.

classDefaults.note: IsMHFDS=true and LLink_Face_Subj='testtzest' in the project's saved asset are Dylan's local instance state, not Epic defaults.
